evidence: Plin. NH 14.113 (Lewis & Short: “a beverage made of honey and water, honey-water, mead, hydromel”)
terms.comment: Greek ὑδρόμελι, honey-water: a drink of honey and water, not of wine. Mulsum is wine sweetened with honey, another drink (see honey wine). Short o and e, as in Lewis & Short.

sources: Lewis & Short: hydromeli
